text: A sense of curiosity stirs within me as I stand in this bright, quiet technological space, greeted by the imposing clarity of glass and the subtle hum of climate control. I feel anticipation: each step brings me closer to discovery. Crossing into a space marked ‘R+D,’ surrounded by vibrant, patterned walls, screens pulsing with information, I sense the presence of human ingenuity and possibility. I am struck by an awareness of progress, of the desire to understand and improve – a tiny exhilaration at the threshold of innovation.
